input.overview: Shooting either outer orbit three times qualifies Make the Pizza at the right oven scoop, while O-V-E-N and three right-ramp locks qualify Handle the Rush. Make the Pizza is the cleaner first start: complete its orbit shots, then shoot the right oven scoop. Handle the Rush takes more work—spell O-V-E-N at the lower lanes, lock three balls at the right oven ramp, then shoot either scoop.
input.simpleOverview: Shoot either outer orbit three times to qualify Make the Pizza, then shoot the right oven scoop to start its Multiball. For Handle the Rush, spell O-V-E-N at the lower lanes, lock three balls at the right oven ramp, then shoot either scoop.

quickInfo.summary: Use three Noid-orbit shots for Lost Topping or three center-ramp shots for Pizza Dispatch, then the right scoop.

steps.text: Shoot either outer orbit three times to qualify Make the Pizza; its insert and the right oven scoop flash when ready.
Shoot the right oven scoop to start Make the Pizza as a Multiball.
During an Operations Multiball, hit flashing shots to qualify Jackpots, then shoot the oven ramp to collect them.
For a repeat, use the Noid orbit three times for Lost Topping or the center ramp three times for Pizza Dispatch, then return to the right scoop.

alternatives.title: Handle the Rush route
alternatives.when: Use this when the lower lanes and right ramp are registering reliably.

steps.text: Spell O-V-E-N at the lower inlanes and outlanes; use the flipper buttons to lane-change the lit letters.
Shoot the right oven ramp to lock three balls.
After the third lock, shoot either the left or right scoop to start Handle the Rush Multiball.
Build Career points with pop-bumper hits or the left scoop, then start each qualified Career Multiball at the left scoop.
Play the right-side Operations Multiballs from the right scoop; completing one side's track qualifies World's Fastest Pizza Maker.
Complete the other side's track to qualify Global Conquest, then use the lit scoop shown by the machine.

machineSetup: Prefer software v006. Version v005 scoring and anomalous behavior can differ, so follow the display.
Check both scoops, the Noid and outer orbits, the center and oven ramps, all five Tracker targets, and every O-V-E-N lane before competition.

cautions.issue: The detailed rules card is labeled for v005, while v006 is the last public release.
cautions.response: Use the physical qualifications and starts, but treat display state and current-machine behavior as authoritative for values and any v006 difference.
